title: Unique exact-derived transport of scalar coherence
statement: Let an arbitrary preorder index two families of abelian categories with derived categories, exact additive scalar functors T and t, and exact additive section functors G. Let theta identify G followed by t with T followed by G. Given coherent ordinary associators and units O and prescribed isomorphisms c from each exact derived T to a chosen TD, there exists a unique family D of derived sheaf and module associators and units. Its cochain representative equations use sigma=Q(c inverse) followed by the exact factorization, its section comparison is inverse source compositor, localized theta, target compositor and c, and it satisfies the derived section, unit and four-stage equations. Equality of section identifications preserves this normalized comparison.

source.place: Tag 04VG, localization of natural transformations; localization portion of lem-weil-sections-scalar-derived-transport, proof steps 5--8, with exactness supplied

proof.text: Construct binary maps using the inverse exact-derived compositor, localized ordinary associator, and c at the edges. Construct units using the exact-derived identity comparison. Factorization equations give all cochain representative equations.

Pasting of exact-derived transformations preserves every ordinary square, unit and four-stage equation. Conjugate by c; internal inverse comparisons cancel. The section comparison is precisely thetaDerived.

Precompose any competing map with Q and use its representative equation. Cancel the invertible target sigma or module factorization. Full faithfulness of precomposition with localization gives equality. An isomorphism is determined by its hom.
